topics.title: Sample freezer short storage
topics.rule: Sample freezer short storage concerns sealed research samples. This ordinary service requires approval from a laboratory coordinator. The permitted duration is 7 days. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Sample freezer short storage, the applicant must attach a specimen barcode and custody signature. Keep that record in the FreezeBox register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Storage Expiry Extension
topics.rule: Storage Expiry Extension concerns sealed research samples. This restricted service requires approval from a biosafety officer. The permitted duration is 45 days. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Storage Expiry Extension, the applicant must attach a specimen barcode and custody signature. Keep that record in the FreezeBox register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Garden irrigation standard booking
topics.rule: Garden irrigation standard booking concerns community garden watering slots. This ordinary service requires approval from a plot steward. The permitted duration is 2 hours. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Garden irrigation standard booking, the applicant must attach a plot number and water meter reading. Keep that record in the GardenFlow register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Drought Emergency Watering
topics.rule: Drought Emergency Watering concerns community garden watering slots. This restricted service requires approval from the water committee. The permitted duration is 30 minutes. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Drought Emergency Watering, the applicant must attach a plot number and water meter reading. Keep that record in the GardenFlow register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Fleet battery routine charging
topics.rule: Fleet battery routine charging concerns shared electric cart charging bays. This ordinary service requires approval from a fleet dispatcher. The permitted duration is 4 hours. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Fleet battery routine charging, the applicant must attach a vehicle tag and battery inspection form. Keep that record in the CartVolt register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Damaged Battery Isolation
topics.rule: Damaged Battery Isolation concerns shared electric cart charging bays. This restricted service requires approval from a safety engineer. The permitted duration is 24 hours. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Damaged Battery Isolation, the applicant must attach a vehicle tag and battery inspection form. Keep that record in the CartVolt register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: Museum loan condition review
topics.rule: Museum loan condition review concerns fictional exhibit loans. This ordinary service requires approval from a collections registrar. The permitted duration is 10 days. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For Museum loan condition review, the applicant must attach a condition photograph and insurance reference. Keep that record in the ExhibitPass register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.

topics.title: International Loan Review
topics.rule: International Loan Review concerns fictional exhibit loans. This restricted service requires approval from an export curator. The permitted duration is 40 days. A request for the other service follows its separate policy and cannot substitute this authorization.
topics.record: For International Loan Review, the applicant must attach a condition photograph and insurance reference. Keep that record in the ExhibitPass register before service starts. Missing attachments mean the request cannot proceed.
